title: Independent reading: John 17:1–8
subtitle: Read prayer as interconnected requests and claims.
overview: John 17 interweaves address, imperative request, purpose clause, and explanatory claim. Map the prayer’s clauses rather than flattening all statements into one speech act.
Pronouns and repeated δόξα language connect the Father, Son, disciples, and the purpose of the request.

items.grc: πάτερ, ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα· δόξασόν σου τὸν υἱόν.
items.en: Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son.

items.grc: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ αἰώνιος ζωή, ἵνα γινώσκωσιν σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν θεόν.
items.en: And this is eternal life: that they may know you, the only true God.
